```{r}
pre_gpa <- runif(1000,max=4,min=0)
sumschl <- pre_gpa <1.5
ss_effect <- rnorm(1000,.5,.2)
noise <- rnorm(1000,0,.2)
fgpa_nss <- pre_gpa + noise
fgpa_ss <- pre_gpa + noise + ss_effect
fgpa_obs <- pre_gpa + noise + sumschl*ss_effect
sum_sch_df <- data.frame(pre_gpa, sumschl, ss_effect, noise, fgpa_nss,fgpa_ss,fgpa_obs)

head(sum_sch_df)

sumsch_lm1 <- lm(fgpa_obs ~ sumschl, data = sum_sch_df)
summary(sumsch_lm1)
```
